name: CodingBunny Easy Chat Lite
author: CodingBunny

sections.description:
CodingBunny Easy Chat is the most effortless and native way of communication for your visitors. It allows you to embed a well-used and popular messenger on your website and establish an easy communication tool for your clients. You will be able to stay in touch with your audience anytime and anywhere, answering from any device.

Features

  • Set up your “WhatsApp” or “WhatsApp Business” number
  • Set a custom pre-filled message
  • Set a custom tooltip message
  • Choose whether to display the button on all devices or only on mobile
  • Choose whether to display the button to the right or left of the display
  • Choose from various types of pre-set icons and set color and size

PRO Features

  • Choose when to display the button by setting days and times
  • Precisely adjusts the horizontal and vertical position of the button
  • Upload your own custom image or icon
  • Other available style settings
sections.installation:
The plugin is simple to install:

  • Download coding-bunny-easy-chat.zip
  • Unzip
  • Upload coding-bunny-easy-duplicate-post directory to your /wp-content/plugins directory
  • Go to the plugin menu page and activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Does CodingBunny Easy Chat comply with the GDPR?

Absolutely! Our plugin does not retain any sensitive data because it directs users directly to WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business.

Does it work with multilingual sites?

Yes, you can use translation plugins like LocoTranslate to translate it into any language quickly and easily.

I am having some problems. How can I find help?

Contact our support here: https://coding-bunny.com/support/

Can I purchase the CodingBunny Easy Chat PRO plugin?

Absolutely! The pro version comes with additional features and advanced support from our team in case of problems.
